title: Scaling Graph Query Processing: Focused Exploration on Partitions Using Load Balancing
abstract: arXiv:2610.32015v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The focus of this paper is on query processing and not search (approximate or exact). The goal is to find all or k answers and the expressiveness of a query (as opposed to a search expression which is typically simpler) is considered important. Although SQL query processing has matured over the last several decades, query processing over graph data has not received the same attention. Only recently, systems, such as Neo4J, and others have started using graphs for data representation on a large scale. Their approaches and algorithms remain proprietary.   In this paper, we address the problem of answering graph queries and their efficient processing on arbitrary-sized graphs. We propose the partitioning of graphs and the use of the distributed paradigm to achieve efficiency and scalability. translated_title: 扩展图查询处理：基于负载均衡的分区聚焦探索
translated_abstract: 本文的重点是查询处理而非搜索（无论是近似的还是精确的）。目标是找出全部或k个答案，并且查询的表达能力（与通常较为简单的搜索表达式相比）被视为重要因素。尽管SQL查询处理在过去几十年中已经成熟，但针对图数据的查询处理却未受到同等的关注。直到最近，Neo4J等系统才开始大规模使用图进行数据表示，但它们的方法和算法仍然是专有的。本文致力于解决图查询的回答问题及其在任意规模图上的高效处理。我们提出对图进行划分，并利用分布式范式来实现高效性和可扩展性。我们的方法以一个子图作为查询输入，其中包括通配符和比较操作。我们的分区方法利用聚焦探索……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出将图划分与分布式范式相结合，通过负载均衡驱动的聚焦探索，在任意规模的图上实现表达能力丰富的图查询的高效、可扩展处理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes combining graph partitioning with the distributed paradigm, leveraging load-balanced focused exploration to efficiently and scalably process expressive graph queries on arbitrarily sized graphs.
